answer: The wander register is checked at draw time, velvet lists the eligible set, and pigment seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 51 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 51 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 9 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
